releases.name: v0.13.0 - deterministic changed-code PR gate
releases.body:
## Highlights

- `gavel pr-check`: deterministic commit-snapshot gate for new attributable occurrences on added or replacement lines (exit `0` / `1` / `2`, snippet-free JSON). Historical debt, duplicates, pure renames, and protected base policy stay outside the blocking verdict.
- Dead-locator candidates include the declaration line, so a newly added declaration is attributed without blaming an unchanged locator whose consumer was deleted.
- PR snapshots omit unrelated mobile binaries and report assets from the Git object buffer.
- Azure Repos template `templates/azure-pipelines/pr-static-check.yml` captures the merge parent, verifies the scanner, and publishes the artifact. Enabling the branch policy remains a separate step.

## Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @dsolisp/gavel@0.13.0
npx gavel --version
```

## Changed-code gate

```bash
npx --yes @dsolisp/gavel@0.13.0 pr-check <repo> --base <captured-target> --head <captured-merge> --json
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dsolisp/gavel/blob/v0.13.0/CHANGELOG.md#0130---2026-10-09) and [docs/PR_CHECK.md](https://github.com/dsolisp/gavel/blob/v0.13.0/docs/PR_CHECK.md).

releases.name: v0.12.5 — POM contract beyond C#
releases.body:
## Highlights

- POM contract beyond C#: `thin-wrapper`, `private-locator-alias`, `new-locator-shadow`, and `fat-method` now fire on TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, and Java (same verdicts; no new rule ids).
- Precision corpora for `thin-wrapper` and `private-locator-alias` (C# + TS).
- Hint firewall: do not invent `clickX()` wrappers or replace stable ids/`By.id` with `getByText(...)`.
- `new-locator-shadow` confidence: C# medium; non-C# same-file overrides low.

## Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @dsolisp/gavel@0.12.5
npx gavel --version
```

## CI gate

```bash
npx --yes @dsolisp/gavel@0.12.5 audit --format sarif > gavel.sarif
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dsolisp/gavel/blob/v0.12.5/CHANGELOG.md#0125---2026-09-30).

releases.name: v0.11.0 — Remediation Loop
releases.body:
## v0.11.0 — Remediation Loop

Closes the detect → suggest → fix → verify loop: the scanner now tells agents *how* to fix findings, cuts false positives on `hardcoded-env` and `brittle-assert`, adds adoption/fixture-utilization scanners and CI-history flakiness scoring, and the orchestrator contract mandates post-refactor review and parallel delegation. Also ships GitHub Copilot native discovery and the v0.10.x ecosystem cleanup.

### Added
- **`fix:` remediation hints** in `self-check` (text/JSON/SARIF), context-aware per wait `subCase`; SARIF `fixes` array renders inline in Code Scanning.
- **Adoption scanner** (`gavel adoption`, report-only): `unused-helper` + `unused-fixture`.
- **Flakiness scoring** (`gavel flakiness`): Playwright JSON + JUnit/Surefire XML → per-test score; mixed outcome = flaky, fail-every-retry = real failure. CLI-only (not wired into `suite-health.js`).
- **Orchestrator quality gates**: post-refactor review + parallel delegation pattern.
- **GitHub Copilot native discovery** via `.vscode/settings.json` (`chat.agentSkillsLocations` / `chat.agentFilesLocations`).

### Fixed
- `hardcoded-env` env-wrapper recognition (fallback defaults inside `os.environ.get` / `getenv` / `process.env`).
- `brittle-assert` structure + argument-position parsing (comparison-only; subject-first shapes).
- `.NET` build dirs (`bin`/`obj`/`packages`/`.vs`) excluded from scanning.

### Tier-R remediation hardening (two adversarial cross-review passes)
- `brittle-assert`: drop trailing failure-message arg for function-style equality APIs (reverses a #11 FP regression); `.And.Be(` candidate + scan every matcher call so FluentAssertions chains flag.
- `flakiness`: self-closing `<testcase/>` counted correctly; BOM strip; fail-closed on bad input; skipped excluded; order-derived `eventualPass`.
- `adoption`: comment/string masking (code-only); Playwright `waitFor*` builtins excluded.

### Removed
- `gavel-oms` skill (out of generic scope). Core catalog now 29 skills.

### Gate
`npm run verify` → **EXIT=0** — corpus **8/8 @ 100%** (`brittle-assert` TP=19, FP=0, FN=0), diff-corpus 100%, docs/versions/manifest clean, **30/30** unit tests.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/dsolisp/gavel/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

## gavel v0.10.0 — .NET Ecosystem Parity

Test-quality enforcement now covers the C#/.NET ecosystem end to end, matching the
depth already available for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Java. The same
13-rule constitution — zero new rule tags.

### Added

**gavel-appium profile.** Mobile-native Appium.NET audit: accessibility-first
locators (`AppiumBy.AccessibilityId` > `AndroidUIAutomator` / `IosNsPredicate` >
XPath), native waits, dependency injection, and gesture patterns.

**Selenium C#, full audit.** Promoted from detect-only to complete constitution
coverage; `gavel-selenium` gains a C# section (`FindElement(By.*)`,
`WebDriverWait` / `ExpectedConditions`, DI, run commands).

**Framework detection + freshness.** Recognizes Appium.NET (`Appium.WebDriver`,
pin 8.3.2), Selenium C# (`Selenium.WebDriver`, pin 4.45.0), and Playwright.NET
(`Microsoft.Playwright`, pin 1.61.0) from project references, with correct profile
routing. Detection precedence: Appium → Playwright → Selenium.

**C# rule coverage.** `brittle-assert`, `expect-in-action`, `selector-leak`,
`manual-wait`, `no-di`, `skip-marker`, and `hardcoded-env` recognize C# idioms
across NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, SpecFlow, Reqnroll, and FluentAssertions — via widened
regexes, no new tags.

**Tag extraction.** xUnit `[Trait]` recognized alongside NUnit `[Category]` and
MSTest `[TestCategory]`; `.cs` tag extraction stays runner-agnostic.
`dotnet test --filter` recipes shared across all three .NET profiles.

**Corpus & samples.** `language: cs` corpus at 100% precision, zero false
negatives across every exercising rule. Ships `.NET` sample repositories
(appium-dotnet, selenium-dotnet, playwright-dotnet) and a SpecFlow/Reqnroll fixture.

### Quality gate
- `npm run verify` green — 7 version files pinned at 0.10.0; 30 core + 4 companion
  skills; 6 parsers; 23/23 unit tests.
- Tier-R adversarial cross-review: rounds 1 + 2 remediated.

### Deferred (documented non-goals)
- Subject-first `brittle-assert` / prose-literal widening → v0.11.0 (#11).
- Additional FluentAssertions/MSTest assertion-regex widenings — dropped: no
  corpus-proven, cross-language false-positive-free form.
- Runner-name disambiguation for `.cs` tag extraction — out of scope (would add a
  freshness/profile surface).

### Interface budget
3 irreversible surfaces (gavel-appium profile, Appium detect/freshness, Selenium C#
routing) — a declared exception to the ≤2 budget, justified as one cohesive .NET
ecosystem release.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/dsolisp/gavel/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
